final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS avg_instown FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref COLLATE BINARY = t.transreg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_instown) AS mix_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY ordertypedist), step3 AS (SELECT a.transref, a.ordertypedist, a.avg_instown, a.avg_instown / b.mix_avg AS ratio FROM step1 AS a JOIN step2 AS b ON a.ordertypedist COLLATE BINARY = b.ordertypedist COLLATE BINARY), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_instown) AS overall_avg FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s.transref, s.ordertypedist, s.avg_instown, s.ratio, s.avg_instown - a.overall_avg AS difference FROM step3 AS s JOIN step4 AS a ON a.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE s.avg_instown > a.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_instown), AVG(ratio), AVG(difference) FROM step5
